blocks.summary: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak. "We must get to truth of what happened before, during and after that awful night," the home secretary says while announcing the review. Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help. The BBC understands the government will also freeze fuel duty again in the Budget. 'I'm a single mum on £41,000 and limit my weekly shop to £40.' What do you want from the Budget? People earning from £380 a month to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget.
